bots.name: Grusel-Bot
bots.text: Horror-Kurzfilm mit Erzähler: Mumien, Geister, verlassene Orte.
bots.beispiel: a creepy bandaged mummy wakes up in an ancient tomb and chases an explorer
ideen: a haunted lighthouse keeper's lantern turns on by itself every midnight and lures sailors to a ghost ship
a scarecrow walks through a foggy cornfield at night hunting crows that stole its button eyes
an abandoned carnival ride starts spinning by itself in the rain and a shadow waves from the top
a forgotten porcelain doll walks down a moonlit hallway and the paintings' eyes follow it
a ghost train arrives at an empty station at 3 am and its doors open by themselves
a swamp witch's lantern floats over black water and fireflies form a skull

bots.name: Cartoon-Bot
bots.beispiel: a tiny fox finds a fallen star and brings it back to the sky
ideen: a tiny robot gardener tries to grow the biggest pumpkin in town and it floats away like a balloon
a shy cloud learns to make rainbows to cheer up a gloomy village
a penguin chef opens an ice-cream truck in the desert
a tiny dragon tries to light birthday candles but sneezes fireworks across the kitchen
a snail racer upgrades its shell with a rocket and wins the garden grand prix
a lonely snowman builds himself a friend just before the sun comes out

bots.name: Anime-Kampf-Bot
bots.text: Anime-Kampfszene mit Effekten, Impact-Frames und schnellen Schnitten.
bots.beispiel: two rival sword masters clash on a burning bridge
ideen: a lightning-fast fox spirit duels a giant stone golem in a bamboo forest
two rival sky pirates clash on top of a flying airship during a thunderstorm
a young mage with a fire whip battles a frost dragon on a frozen lake
a samurai with a blade of pure water fights a lava demon inside an erupting volcano
a cyber ninja races across neon rooftops and clashes with a mechanical tiger
a moon priestess deflects a meteor storm with a giant glowing shield

bots.name: Kino-Bot
bots.text: Realistischer Kurzfilm im Blockbuster-Look mit Erzähler.
bots.beispiel: a lone astronaut discovers a glowing forest on a frozen moon
ideen: a deep-sea diver discovers a glowing city at the bottom of the ocean
a lone rider races a sandstorm across a red desert toward a hidden oasis
an astronaut repairs a satellite while a meteor shower lights up the earth below
a firefighter carries a child out of a burning skyscraper as the floor collapses
a pilot lands a damaged plane on a frozen lake at night
a mountain climber reaches the summit as an avalanche thunders below

bots.name: Welten-Bot
bots.text: Epische Naturgewalten und Weltall, durchgehende Kamerafahrt ohne Menschen.
bots.beispiel: a colossal ringed planet rising over a glowing alien ocean
ideen: a volcano erupts under the northern lights while lava meets the sea
a gigantic waterfall pours off the edge of a floating island into the clouds
a supercell storm forms over endless golden wheat fields at sunset
a glowing jellyfish swarm rises through a deep ocean trench toward the moonlight
a black hole bends the light of a nearby galaxy into a burning ring
a desert canyon floods with a sudden flash flood under a lightning sky

bots.name: Drachen-Bot
bots.text: Fantasy-Epos: Drachen, Burgen, Magie - eigene Welten, eigene Figuren.
bots.beispiel: a giant crystal dragon wakes up under a frozen castle and breathes blue fire into the sky
ideen: a young knight rides a storm dragon through a thunder cloud to save a floating city
a golden dragon guards a waterfall temple and battles a shadow serpent
a baby dragon hatches in a volcano and its first flame lights up a whole valley
a sky castle is attacked by a swarm of fire wyverns at sunset
an old wizard summons a dragon made of stars above a sleeping village
a sea dragon rises from a whirlpool and splits a pirate ship in two

bots.name: Tier-Action-Bot
bots.text: Süße und wilde Tiere in Action-Szenen - Cartoon-Look, viel Bewegung.
bots.beispiel: a fluffy hamster drifts a tiny race car through a kitchen obstacle course
ideen: a cat in a superhero cape leaps across city rooftops chasing a robot mouse
a squad of penguins snowboards down a giant glacier and launches off an ice ramp
a turbo turtle with jet boots races a cheetah across the savanna
a raccoon heist crew sneaks through a museum of shiny treasures
a corgi pilot flies a paper airplane through a thunderstorm
a gecko climbs a skyscraper during a neon festival and catches a falling balloon
